description:
v1.0 | 30 gates | 11 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Adds two 4-bit numbers, or subtracts them when the mode pin is on.

Use this where a creation needs both addition and subtraction, such as a simple calculator.

Feed it two binary numbers, lowest bit first, and a mode input. With the mode off, the numbers are added and the carry output shows the carry out of the addition. With the mode on, the second number is taken away from the first, and the same output shows the borrow, which is on when the first number is smaller.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): a = x 0-3, b = x 4-7, mode = x 8 (on subtracts).
Outputs (green gates): result = x 0-3, carry or borrow = x 4.

Profile: small, the build with the fewest gates for this size.
How it works: One small cell per bit; the carry walks from bit to bit.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.

Other sizes, the generator and the full explanation:
